pathAssumptions.schedule: Path linear between O/H/L/C at 0/5/10/15 minutes. Actual scans at M15 boundaries plus 60s in dynamic cases; static early candle HOLD cases compressed. Source quote protection precedes 10s app management.
limitations: M15 retained OHLC does not identify exact intrabar ordering/timing; two paths are sensitivity witnesses, not exhaustive bounds.
Synthetic constant pair spreads derive all bid/ask candle features and quotes coherently from midpoint; this changes historical side anchors and is an explicit alternative price world.
Native component path pairs independent side extrema synchronously by assumption; actual simultaneous spread/liquidity unknown.
Current captured instrument margin/precision metadata is applied retrospectively. Local leverage/risk rules remain actual; no historical metadata or latency parity.
Settlement home factors use modeled midpoint cross rates with the declared fee once into AUD; source quotes and cross rates remain modeled, not retained account factors.
Unrealized conversion uses the declared neutral position factor. Instrument marking remains the supplied liquidation-side proxy, not a claim of exact v20 margin NAV.
No financing events supplied; no exact total historical cost claim.
No forced end close, annual cash reset, episode reset, risk-gate override, optimization or untouched holdout.

costFieldDefinitions.grossBeforeEstimatedFrictionAud: Midpoint entry-to-exit price movement at neutral position conversion; a fixed-timing decomposition, not an alternative strategy return.
costFieldDefinitions.executionFrictionAud: Midpoint movement minus executable price P/L, both at neutral AUD conversion, plus lifetime commission.
costFieldDefinitions.homeConversionCostAud: Executable price P/L at neutral AUD conversion minus broker settled P/L; settlement markup is already included exactly once in netAud.
costFieldDefinitions.estimatedExecutionFrictionAud: Legacy summary name for total modeled friction: executionFrictionAud + homeConversionCostAud. Financing is separate.

financing.disclosure: No historical financing charges supplied. Session close precedes usual rollover; any residual rollover or fee is unresolved.

interpretation: Complete eight-case reduction only. Cases are separately evolving conditional accounts, not independent strategy trials, exact historical executions, or an untouched holdout. No economic recommendation is selected by this tool.
limits: Gross/friction decomposition fixes the actual modeled entry/exit times and does not rerun an alternative costless strategy.
Historical financing is unavailable. Inspect cutoff crossings and open boundary exposure before interpreting net returns.
Export-based checks cover serialized trading/decision/episode evidence; complete hidden intent/quarantine tables are not exported. See erratum.
A retained JSON alone does not prove a successful child exit; preserve launcher exit/test logs and any runtime-repair sidecar in the trial ledger.
